title: Source-library derived projection formula for etale sum extension
statement: Let A be a Grothendieck abelian symmetric monoidal closed category, with monoidal preadditivity and functorial flat resolutions. Let f : U → X be an etale morphism of schemes. Assume inverse image preserves flat objects, each tensorLeft M preserves the filtered colimits of the site size, and the sheafification weak equivalences on both small etale sites are monoidal. On the unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], equip left derived inverse image with its canonical monoidal structure for the derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. The projection transformation of the adjunction D(f_!) ⊣ L(f^*) is an isomorphism at every object K of D(X_et,A), where f_! is etale sum extension [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension].

source.place: Projection section, theorem isIso_projectionMap_derivedEtaleLowerShriek, lines 423–474; Stacks Tag 0GKF.

proof.text: Choose a functorial flat-term K-flat resolution of a complex representing K. Inverse image preserves its K-flatness. On a pair of cochain complexes the derived projection component, after the canonical localization tensor comparisons, is the localization of the ordinary cochain projection component. The latter is invertible by the sheaf sum-extension projection formula. The localization tensor comparisons are invertible because the first factors are K-flat. Hence the projection component on these representatives is invertible.

Every derived object is isomorphic to the image of a cochain complex, and the resolved first factor is isomorphic to K. Naturality in each variable transfers the component isomorphisms along those isomorphisms. Componentwise invertibility proves invertibility of the projection natural transformation. This is the existing, fully proved source-library theorem; no new Lean proof or assumption is introduced.

theorem isIso_projectionMap_derivedEtaleLowerShriek {U : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f]
    [(f)^*[A].PreservesFlat]
    [∀ M : A, PreservesFilteredColimitsOfSize.{u, u + 1} (tensorLeft M)]
    [(U.smallEtaleTopology.W (A := A)).IsMonoidal] [(X.smallEtaleTopology.W (A := A)).IsMonoidal]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A)) :
    letI := leftDerivedUpperStarMonoidal A f
    IsIso (Functor.Monoidal.projectionMap
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekLeftDerivedUpperStarAdjunction (A := A) f) K)
